item.title: Roundabout has disappeared, 10th August
item.description:
The mini roundabout markings have all but completely disappeared. It's not obvious whether the roundabout has been badly 'blacked out' or whether the markings have just disappeared rapidly, however, the roundabout signs are still present. It has caused a number of near misses where drivers are not treating it like a roundabout and not giving way to the right. Those coming from Lennard Rd towards New Beckenham station seem to think they have right of way.

item.title: Fallen branches blocking access to 7/8 E, F, G. 8E totally inaccessible to rear graves due to overgrown brambles, trees, ivy. Some areas in 7F/G dangerous to access due to deep brambles blocking access, 10th August
item.description:
This area of woodland graves is largely inaccessible due to out of control bramble growth and unkempt trees and ivy blocking access. It is dangerous to attempt to access graves in some areas due to deep bramble growith. Some low kerbs and headstones are literaly buried under the undergrowth which is a huge tripping hazard. Completely inaccessible for anyone with a disability or elderly to access family graves. From the fact that there are large fallen branches blocking access to the path indicates that urgent attention also needs to be given to tree maintanance to ensure safety during seasonal winds.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): North Road, Finchley, Greater London

I have video evidence of the trespassing. This is an ongoing issue and has been reported previously someone from the council came out and had spoken to them regarding the rubbish its been reported multiple occasions. But they are ignoring it and have started to dump rubbish again and trespass when they please.
